title: Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge (Microsoft Game Studios - Xbox, 2003) CIB
descriptionText:
See pics.

Immerse yourself in the thrilling dogfights of World War II with Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge for the Microsoft Xbox. This simulation game, released in 2003 by Microsoft Game Studios, lets you take to the skies as a daring pilot on a quest for revenge. With a T-Teen rating, this game is suitable for gamers of all ages.

This complete in box (CIB) edition includes all the necessary components for installation. The game is specifically designed for the Microsoft Xbox platform and features stunning graphics and realistic gameplay. Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey through the skies with Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge.
